text: cool. give me on the terrain tool the ability to paint water into terrain
resolution: Added a WATER mode to the terrain tool so you paint organic water straight onto the ground (not just drop rect/disc bodies). Pick water in the terrain modes, set the height slider to the level, and brush — wherever you paint, terrain fills with water to that level; depth derives against the bed (dig under it for deeper), erase clears it. Reuses the whole water pipeline: the chunk gained a water HeightField (painted via stampBrush, wet where level greater than 0), carried through the chunk-to-floor bridge as a field-backed WaterBody per wet chunk (floorsToWaterBodies, identity-cached), flowing into world.waterBodies beside dropped bodies. Renders (editor wavy heightfield + compiled WATER lump with ZERO new Zig — painted water is just another grid the loader already animates), wades via footing, persists (RLE in mapStore). WaterBody gained optional field; resolvers sample it per cell. 8 water tests pass; modules parse clean. Compiled needs only a game bake.
